verses.text: Then I said, "Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel. You should know what justice is.
But you hate what is good and love what is evil. You tear the skin off my people and the flesh from their bones.
You eat my people's flesh, strip off their skin, and break their bones. You chop them up like meat for the pot, like flesh for a cooking pan."
Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.
This is what the LORD says about the prophets who lead my people astray: "If you feed them, they promise peace. But if you do not give them food, they declare war on you.
So night will come over you, and you will have no visions. Darkness will cover you, and you will not be able to tell the future. The sun will set on the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.
The seers will be ashamed, and the fortune-tellers will be disgraced. They will all cover their faces, because God will not answer them."
But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and strength, to tell Jacob about his rebellion and Israel about his sin.
Listen to this, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel, who hate justice and twist everything that is right.
You build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with wickedness.
Her leaders judge for bribes. Her priests teach for pay. Her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they rely on the LORD and say, "Isn't the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us."
So because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field. Jerusalem will become a pile of rubble, and the temple hill will be covered with thickets.
